subject: change encoding version to version (#325)
reason: The change renames InfoIndexPartitionResponse field 16 from encoding_version to version and feeds it from the per-index monotonic entry.version() instead of the constant entry.encoding_version() (always 1). This value is used only for the internal cross-node consistency check in the FT.INFO <idx> PRIMARY/CLUSTER fanout OnResponse handlers and is never included in any client reply (neither GenerateReply nor local-scope FT.INFO emits it). In any converged coordinator cluster both builds return identical FT.INFO CLUSTER/PRIMARY output, so a compared command sequence would be an unreached-change e
